content: Official Hyperbeam docs enumerate browser-session controls: Chromium sessions accept a start URL and options including kiosk mode; sessions are explicitly terminated; user roles distinguish input control from other permissions and roles can be toggled for individuals. Kasm session sharing defaults to initiator control with guests view-only, and warns simultaneous multi-user input can create inconsistent UX. These product docs support lifecycle plus explicit single-controller permissions as expected shared-browser affordances, not a need to copy their hosted architecture.
